body:
# -Manhunt

**This is really bad. If you're doing a yt manhunt, use another mod.**

## Features

This adds:
/speedrunner {player} (Sets the player to the runner)
/hunter {player} (Sets the player to the hunter)
/manhunt start (Starts the manhunt)
/manhunt reset (Resets the manhunt)

## Why should you download this?
1. Do a manhunt with ease.
2. Set the runner with ease.
3. Set the hunter with ease.
